headline: Barracuda ESG, Chrome and Outlook flaws join CISA KEV; trusted AWS access abused in cloud breaches; Xen Orchestra exploitation continues

bullets.text: Changed: CISA added six exploited flaws on 11-10: Barracuda CVE-2026-116606 (ESG auth bypass) and CVE-2026-111560 (command injection), due 11-13; Chrome CVE-2026-125350, Outlook CVE-2026-124194, Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320 and Openwave CVE-2026-111793, due 11-24.
Changed: attackers are abusing trusted AWS access to breach multiple cloud environments (BleepingComputer). The brief gives no product or CVE; this is an access-trust problem, not a patchable bug.

Changed: an SGLang RCE exploit was used to breach NEAR AI, stealing data from 18 agents and about 100 users. Separately, Git patched a flaw that lets malicious repositories run code during recursive clones.
Still active: Xen Orchestra critical auth bypass is being exploited for admin access (now reported by two outlets); the brief names no CVE or fixed release.

Still active: N-able keeps hosted N-central offline after dozens of published zero-days (4 outlets). SSHole (OpenSSH CVE-2026-123158), GPUStack, FreeSwitch and IBM Aspera Faspex KEV deadlines fall on 11-12.

Breaches: Nitori says 37.6M customer records were stolen; Vanderbilt University hit by BYOD ransomware (5 outlets). 300 malicious packages listed in 7 days, mostly npm; the week ran 1.05x the 90-day average.

actions: Barracuda ESG: patch CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 before the 11-13 KEV deadline and check appliances for root compromise.
Update Chrome (CVE-2026-125350) and Outlook (CVE-2026-124194) across the fleet now; patch Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320.
AWS: review cross-account roles and third-party trust relationships, and look for unexpected AssumeRole activity in CloudTrail.
Patch OpenSSH (CVE-2026-123158), GPUStack, FreeSwitch and IBM Aspera Faspex before the 11-12 KEV deadline.
Update Git, avoid recursive clones of untrusted repositories, and patch or isolate SGLang servers.
Xen Orchestra and N-central: restrict management interfaces to admin networks and watch vendors for fixes.
